description_en: Tests the connectivity to the Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) authentication server configured for a Bastionhost instance. Use this operation to validate your LDAP settings before you save them
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost verify-instance-ldap-auth-server --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server 192.168.XX.XX --port 389 --base-dn dc=test,dc=com --account cn=Manager,dc=test,dc=com --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyInstanceLDAPAuthServer

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Bastionhost instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 堡垒机的实例ID。 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Bastionhost instance. For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh: 堡垒机的区域ID。 Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The address of the standby server
parameters.name: standby_server

parameters.help_en: The port used to access the server
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether SSL is supported. Valid values:

true: supported

false: not supported
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持SSL。取值：

true：支持
false：不支持
parameters.name: is_ssl

parameters.help_en: The password of the server account
parameters.name: password

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. This parameter can be used for troubleshooting and issue locating
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
